source.name: SportsPro: San Diego Padres team up with Motorola for first MLB jersey patch deal
source.note: Reports the agreement at US$10 million a year, attributed to SportBusiness. The club's own release (MLB.com, 2022-04-19) dates the patch from the 2023 season; the wider sponsorship and the official smartphone partnership began in 2022.
source.quote: The agreement, reported by SportBusiness to be worth US$10 million a year, also sees Motorola named as the franchise’s official smartphone partner.

note: Jersey patch (shoulder/sleeve). Announced 19 April 2022, from the 2023 season.
